description: Report session state to tmag. Fails open: never blocks or alters a turn.

hooks.command: for r in "${TMUX_PLUGIN_MANAGER_PATH%/}" "$HOME/.tmux/plugins" "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/tmux/plugins"; do case $r in /*) t="$r/tmux-agent-experience/bin/tmag"; [ -x "$t" ] && exec "$t" hook claude 2>/dev/null;; esac; done; t=$(command -v tmag) && exec "$t" hook claude 2>/dev/null; exit 0
